account.title: Create your account
account.intro: This is the first account on this instance, and it is the one that owns the Google connection. Nothing here leaves the machine haelan is running on.
account.nameHint: Shown on your own pages. Nobody else sees it.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. There is no reset link: this instance sends no email.
account.timezoneHint: Every day boundary is computed in this zone, so a night that ends at 07:00 belongs to the right day. Change it later and the days are recomputed.

instanceUrl.title: How you reach this instance
instanceUrl.intro: Google has to be told the exact address it sends you back to after you grant consent, and it has to match what your browser actually used. Pick how you reach haelan.

localhost.title: This machine
localhost.detail: You open haelan in a browser on the machine it runs on. Google exempts loopback from its HTTPS rule, so this works with no certificate.

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.detail: Your tailnet name, which is a real hostname with a real certificate. Reachable from your phone without exposing anything to the internet.

proxy.title: Reverse proxy
proxy.detail: A hostname you own, terminating HTTPS in front of haelan. You already have the certificate.

instanceUrl.addressHint: Google refuses a raw IP address as a redirect target, so a LAN address like the one your router hands out is not an option here, whatever it says in your browser bar. Loopback and real hostnames are.

google.title: Connect Google
google.intro: This is the one step nobody can automate. Google exposes no API for creating an OAuth client, so you create one once, in the console, and paste it back here.
google.step1After: and create a project, or pick an existing one.
google.step2: Under APIs and services, enable the Google Health API.
google.step3: Configure the OAuth consent screen and declare the {{count}} scopes listed below, even the data types you do not want today: declaring is once, granting is per person, and a scope you skip now means a second visit later. The console sorts them into sensitive and restricted groups by itself, which is expected.
google.publishingWarning: Leaving it in Testing gives every refresh token a seven day life, and the household's sync stops a week after setup with no obvious cause.
google.step5: Create an OAuth client of type Web application, and register every redirect URI below in one pass. An unused URI costs nothing. A missing one costs a return trip.
google.step6: Copy the client ID and secret into the fields underneath.
google.unverifiedNote: Your client is unverified, and it will stay that way. Every person granting consent sees an unverified app warning, which is expected here and is not a sign anything is wrong: verification exists to lift a hundred user cap that a household instance never reaches.

backfill.title: Filling in your history
backfill.intro: haelan is walking backwards from today, most recent first, so the days you are most likely to look at arrive first. You can leave this page. It resumes where it stopped if the instance restarts, and the trailing week is fetched every run regardless.
backfill.runningNote: Running. {{finished}} of {{total}} data types have reached their horizon.
backfill.idleNote: Idle. {{finished}} of {{total}} data types have reached their horizon.
backfill.horizonQuestion: How far back should haelan go?
backfill.horizonNote: Minute level detail is kept for the last {{intradayDays}} days whichever you pick, because it is most of the size. This chooses how far back the daily history goes. Changing it later re-aims the walk and never deletes anything already fetched.

connect.title: Connect your Google account
connect.detail: haelan reads your health data from Google. Nothing appears here until you connect.
connect.restoreDetail: Your health data is safe and still here. This instance just can't read the Google credentials it has on file - that's what happens when a database is restored without the instance.key file that encrypted them. It also cost the household's Google client secret, and the instance has already written itself a new instance.key. Connect again to fix it.
connect.wrongAddress: Google will send you back to {{baseUrl}}, which is not the address you are using. Consent will fail. Open haelan at {{baseUrl}}, or ask whoever set this up for a Tailscale or proxy address.

profile.displayNameHint: Shown on your own pages. Nobody else sees it.
profile.usernameHint: What you sign in with. Capitals are folded to lower case, so ROBIN and robin are the same account.
profile.timezoneHint: Every day boundary is computed in this zone, so a night that ends at 07:00 belongs to the right day.
profile.timezoneWarning: Changing this moves every one of your day boundaries. Your whole history is re-derived from the archive the next time haelan starts, which takes several minutes, and until that finishes this account does not sync. Nothing is lost either way.
profile.savedRebuild: Saved. Your history is re-derived from the archive the next time haelan starts, and your days will be wrong until it is.
